interpretation: All p95s use nearest rank from raw successful operation durations; failures remain separate and never disappear into a percentile.
Host counter deltas use only adjacent same-boot intervals wholly inside each UTC phase. No interpolation across boundaries; coverage and actual cadence are explicit.
Host CPU executing excludes idle, iowait and steal. Guest and guest_nice are not added twice. PSI percentages use cumulative stall deltas, not decayed averages.
vmstat swap counters are pages, not bytes. Host swap total/used are explicit; compare runs only after checking configuration and swap differences.
MemAvailable includes reclaimable mapped file cache and does not measure guest resident consumption.
Sentry totals require exactly the target count, unique PIDs and nonoverlapping cgroups, no read errors, and complete required fields. No partial sample is extrapolated.
Sentries match the sampler runtime root; this sampler does not independently retain sandbox IDs. Correlate with dedicated-node benchmark inventory checks.
PSS/RSS are process mapping views; cgroup memory.current is a separate charge view. Never add those views or overlapping memory.stat categories such as file, shmem and file_mapped.
Sentry collection is sequential and its window must fit the phase. No sample proves every process was observed at precisely the same instant.
cpu.max is the sampled leaf cgroup limit; effective ancestor limits are not recorded by this sampler.
Exec diagnostics align by journald completion timestamp; park diagnostics align by recorded start timestamp. Untimestamped execs appear only in aggregate.
Disk await is aggregate device completion accounting, not a measured guest operation delay or proof of the causal bottleneck.
